network_status.summary_it: La relazione copre l'evento regionale, ma non pubblica una misura idrometrica attribuibile al fosso di Lamporecchio e all'attraversamento registrato. I dati del Bisenzio non vengono trasferiti tra bacini distinti.
network_status.summary_en: The report covers the regional event but publishes no hydrometric measurement attributable to the Lamporecchio stream and recorded crossing. Bisenzio data are not transferred between distinct catchments.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
